# pcd_dns_pools_config (Data Source)

Renders and validates the Designate `pools.yaml` for the hosts that carry PCD's `dns` cluster role. PCD offers no API for a pool's targets and nameservers (Designate's pools API stops at name, description, attributes and NS records), so the file still has to reach each DNS host and be applied with `designate-manage pool update --file`. The Designate worker caches the pool, so restart `pf9-designate-worker` on the DNS host afterward, as the DNS guide's example does; the guide shows one way to deliver the file. What this data source adds is the typed schema and the checks that otherwise need a page of variable validation: NS record names end in a dot, hosts are IP literals, ports are in range, a target's options match its type, and master addresses fit the width Designate can store for zones. The checks run when Terraform reads the data source: at plan time when every input is known, and at apply time when an input comes from a value computed in the same apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The pool file for a host carrying the dns cluster role, backed by BIND9 on
# the same host. designate-mdns (port 5354) on the DNS host is the master the
# BIND server transfers zones from; rndc lets Designate add and remove zones.
# BIND listens on 5353: on a PCD host, the dnsmasq that pcdctl prep-node
# installs holds port 53.
data "pcd_dns_pools_config" "default" {
  pools = [{
    name        = "default"
    description = "BIND9 on the DNS host"

    ns_records = [{
      hostname = "ns1.pcd.example.com."
      priority = 1
    }]

    nameservers = [{
      host = "10.0.0.5"
      port = 5353
    }]

    targets = [{
      type = "bind9"
      masters = [{
        host = "10.0.0.5"
        port = 5354
      }]
      options = {
        host          = "10.0.0.5"
        port          = 5353
        rndc_host     = "10.0.0.5"
        rndc_port     = 953
        rndc_key_file = "/etc/designate/rndc.key"
      }
    }]
  }]
}

# yaml is the file to place at /etc/designate/pools.yaml on the DNS host and
# apply with `designate-manage pool update --file /etc/designate/pools.yaml`.
# The Designate worker caches the pool, so restart pf9-designate-worker on the
# DNS host afterward. id changes with the content, so it can trigger the
# delivery. The DNS guide shows a complete delivery with the ssh provider.
output "pools_yaml" {
  value     = data.pcd_dns_pools_config.default.yaml
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pools` (Attributes List) The pools, in file order. Designate matches each by `id` when given, else by `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String, Sensitive) SHA-256 of `yaml`. It changes exactly when the rendered file changes, so it works as the trigger for whatever delivers the file. Sensitive because it is an unsalted hash of `yaml`: anyone who sees it and has the configuration could test guesses at a pdns4 `api_token` offline. It still works as a trigger; plans show that it changed, not its value.
- `yaml` (String, Sensitive) The rendered `pools.yaml`: one document holding the list of pools. Sensitive because pdns4 targets carry an API token.

<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Required:

- `name` (String) The pool name; `default` is the pool PCD creates. A pool's name cannot change after creation.
- `nameservers` (Attributes List) The DNS servers Designate queries to confirm a change has propagated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--nameservers))
- `ns_records` (Attributes List) The NS records that every zone hosted in this pool advertises. Their hostnames are names resolvable outside PCD that point at the pool's nameservers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--ns_records))
- `targets` (Attributes List) The backend servers Designate pushes zones to: one `bind9` target per BIND server, or a `pdns4` target per PowerDNS API endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--targets))

Optional:

- `also_notifies` (Attributes List) Extra servers that receive a NOTIFY on every zone change. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--also_notifies))
- `attributes` (Map of String) Pool attributes used for scheduling zones onto pools (for example `service_tier`).
- `description` (String) A description of the pool.
- `id` (String) The UUID of an existing pool to update in place, as `GET /designate/v2/pools` reports it. Omit to match by name.

<a id="nestedatt--pools--nameservers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.nameservers`

Required:

- `host` (String) The nameserver's IP address.
- `port` (Number) The port, 1 to 65535.


<a id="nestedatt--pools--ns_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.ns_records`

Required:

- `hostname` (String) A fully qualified name ending in a dot.
- `priority` (Number) The record's priority, 1 or greater.


<a id="nestedatt--pools--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.targets`

Required:

- `masters` (Attributes List) The `designate-mdns` servers the backend transfers zones from: the address of each host carrying the `dns` role, port 5354. Keep each address at most 32 characters long: Designate copies them into every zone's masters, whose column is that wide (PCD-9946). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--targets--masters))
- `options` (Attributes) How Designate reaches the backend. `host` and `port` always; `rndc_*` for `bind9`; `api_endpoint` and `api_token` for `pdns4`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools--targets--options))
- `type` (String) `bind9` or `pdns4`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description of the target.

<a id="nestedatt--pools--targets--masters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.targets.masters`

Required:

- `host` (String) The mdns IP address.
- `port` (Number) The port, 1 to 65535.


<a id="nestedatt--pools--targets--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.targets.options`

Required:

- `host` (String) The backend's IP address.
- `port` (Number) The backend's DNS port, 1 to 65535.

Optional:

- `api_endpoint` (String) pdns4: the PowerDNS API URL.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) pdns4: the PowerDNS API key.
- `rndc_config_file` (String) bind9: the path, on the DNS host, of an rndc configuration file that carries the key.
- `rndc_host` (String) bind9: the address rndc connects to. Designate defaults to `127.0.0.1`.
- `rndc_key_file` (String) bind9: the path, on the DNS host, of the rndc key file. One of `rndc_key_file` and `rndc_config_file` is required.
- `rndc_port` (Number) bind9: the rndc control port. Designate defaults to 953.



<a id="nestedatt--pools--also_notifies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.also_notifies`

Required:

- `host` (String) The server's IP address.
- `port` (Number) The port, 1 to 65535.
